summary: Form 6-K filed by Curaleaf Holdings, Inc., a Canadian issuer, announcing the date of its Annual and Special Meeting of shareholders. The meeting will consider routine matters: director elections, auditor appointment, approval of stock plan awards, an amendment to multiple voting shares, an option/RSU exchange, and a continuance from British Columbia to Delaware. The board recommends voting in favor. This is a routine notice of shareholder meeting with no special-situation event; management information circular will follow. No deal terms, pricing, or transaction structure are present.
